present_illness.present_illness: I have been unable to chew food for a long time after biting hard objects with my upper right back teeth. It has worsened recently and I have spontaneous pain.

oral_examination.oral_examination: *16 Cracks can be seen in the mesial groove extending to the mesial face and neck, with looseness (-), percussion pain ( ), and bite examination ( ).

diagnosis.primary: *Treatment plan for longitudinal fracture of tooth 16, acute attack of chronic apical periodontitis *Extraction of tooth 16, elective restoration.

source_handle: *16 Local disinfection with povidone-iodine and infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
